name: Left Ventricle Quantification Challenge
description: Challenge/dataset for evaluating segmentation and regression methods for left-ventricle quantification on mid-ventricular short-axis cardiac MR data.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient for segmentation and mean absolute error (MAE) for quantification/regression
reputation: A well-known challenge in the cardiac MRI research community for benchmarking left-ventricle segmentation and quantification methods.
notes: Clinical dataset with inter-observer variability and limited size; results depend on imaging protocol and preprocessing. Non-LLM benchmark focused on medical imaging.
